items.title: test(state): intercept crash admission without an unbound method
items.summary: test(state): intercept crash admission without an unbound method The native crash fixture added an unlisted method suppression, breaking the production suppression inventory on main. Replace prototype extraction with a native SQLite subclass and super.prepare(), preserving the integrity-scan pause without expanding the allowlist or weakening assertions. The unchanged suppression suite passes all three tests (29.11s shard wall). The existing eight-case crash fixture reaches its IPC pause before and after the change (7.72s and 10.20s). Independent review through P2 is clean. No production behavior changes.
